title: episodes/<id>/publish/* bundle
description: Schemas for files inside <id>/publish/. Single source of truth for cross-platform publishing metadata. Written by script-agent-harness (via export-to-pipeline.js); consumed by astral-video build-publish.sh and future upload tools.

title.description: Platform-specific title (typically <= 80 chars; per-platform limits enforced by uploader).

description.description: Platform-specific description. May contain Markdown / hashtags depending on platform.

category.description: Platform-specific category (e.g. youtube category id, bilibili partition).

thumbnail_path.description: Optional override for cover thumbnail (relative to <id>/publish/ or absolute).

extra.description: Free-form platform-specific extras (e.g. youtube playlist id, bilibili dynamic text).

do_not_publish.description: When true, downstream publishing tools MUST refuse to upload this episode and exit non-zero.

reason.description: Optional human note for why publishing is blocked.
